entries.label: +1 Slab
cells: The Slab in World 5 gives 1.15x bigger bonuses

entries.label: 6 O'Clock Crystals
cells: 4x more Guaranteed Crystal Mobs every day.

entries.label: Best Story Ever Told
cells: 1.5x higher Reward Multi for all Monument Stories in the W5 caverns. Also, reward multi's build up for an extra +50 hours!

entries.label: Big Sig Fig
cells: All your Sigils in Alchemy level up 2.5x faster than normal

entries.label: Blessed Be Thy Luck
cells: 2x better luck when using Blessings in your Sneaking inventory

entries.label: Blue Ribbon Certification
cells: Get +1 more Ribbons every day for your Ribbon Shelf in Cooking

entries.label: Buy One Get One Free
cells: Get 2x more LVs when buying Exotic Market upgrades

entries.label: Cog Lover
cells: You can claim +2 more Jeweled Cogs every day, if you have them unlocked...

entries.label: Coral Restoration
cells: +30% more Daily Coral gained each and every day!

entries.label: Daily Shopping Spree
cells: The first 8 upgrades you buy each day for Masterclasses are 80% cheaper

entries.label: Davey Jones Returns
cells: 1.15x bonus to all the same stats that 'Davey Jones Training' gives, check it in W5 Gemshop. Also, -15% Minimum Travel Time

entries.label: Democracy FTW
cells: The Bonus Ballot gives a +25% higher bonus for the winning bonus of the week

entries.label: Double Aint Enough
cells: ''2x Statue and Gold Food drops'' now drop in bundles of 3x instead!

entries.label: Extended Database
cells: +10 Max LV for 5th column of Farming Land Rank Database

entries.label: Familiar Firesale
cells: Whenever you buy a Summoning Familiar, there's a 40% chance for the cost to not go up at all... almost like it's free!)

entries.label: Flopping a Full House
cells: Actively equipped cards give 1.15x higher bonuses, and this stacks with Lab chips!

entries.label: Furry Friends Forever
cells: The 'rest-of-the-game' bonuses from your friends Orion and Poppy are all 3x bigger

entries.label: Greatest Drop Party Ever
cells: +500% Drop Rate for all players! This bonus is additive, not a multiplier.

entries.label: Inevitable Builder
cells: Gives 1 additional Trimmed Construction Slot, and makes them 1.75x faster!

entries.label: Kruk be Bubblin'
cells: Kattlekruk gives +10 more Bubble LVs per day for each of his bubbles

entries.label: Lightning Fast Naps
cells: 1.25x faster Stamina regeneration for Spelunking

entries.label: May the Best Man Win
cells: The Multi Meritocracy gives a +20% higher multiplier for the winning bonus of the week

entries.label: Midusian Appetite
cells: +500% total Golden Food bonus. This bonus is additive, not a multiplier.

entries.label: Minehead My Beloved
cells: 1.5x Minehead Currency Gain and Damage. Also, opponent gets -1 Depth Charge the 1st, 3rd, and 5th time you upgrade this!

entries.label: More Soot More Salt
cells: Refinery cycles are 1.75x faster

entries.label: Obsolete No More
cells: The Metal Detector bonus from Equinox Valley no longer resets when you find a new best nugget. Also, 1.25x Equinox Bar Fill Rate

entries.label: Opa Opal Style
cells: Villagers at the Hole in World 5 gain 2x more EXP

entries.label: Picasso Gaming
cells: All the bonuses from your Gaming Palette colours are 1.25x higher

entries.label: Purebred Eggs
cells: The chance for eggs in Breeding to rank up, which remember gives higher Mob Power, is 10x higher than normal!

entries.label: Recycled Particle Upgrades
cells: 100% of Unspent 'Alternate Particle Upgrades' each day are spent equally across the 1st bubbles of each colour, for free!

entries.label: Reduced Jail Sentence
cells: 2.5x higher EXP gain for both Laboratory and Divinity

entries.label: Shrine World Order Bill
cells: Introduces a bill to congress that will make Shrines gain EXP from AFK gains no matter what world you're in!

entries.label: Skillium Fancyson
cells: 1.75x higher EXP gain for all skills, except Research and W7 Skill 3!

entries.label: Super Duper Talents
cells: Super Talent PTS give +10 more LVs to talents than they normally do

entries.label: Super Talent Points
cells: You get +1 Super Talent Point at Class LV 500, LV 600, LV 700 and so on. Spend these on Talents to give them +50 LV!

entries.label: Superb Gallerium
cells: The first 2 normal showcase slots in your Gallery are 1 grade higher (i.e. they become Featured, and give 150% bonuses)

entries.label: Thanatos's Teachings
cells: +200% extra kills, for opening portals and Deathnote. This bonus is additive, not a multiplier.

entries.label: The Charms got Rizz
cells: All of your Gold Charms in Sneaking give 1.25x higher bonuses

entries.label: Two Time Jelly Operation
cells: 1.5x Jelly Operator Damage. Also, you get +1 Slot Unlock to use the 1st, 3rd, and 5th time you upgrade this!

entries.label: Whats in your Jar?
cells: 1.2x higher bonuses from all of your Jar Collectibles in Cavern 11

entries.label: Wowa Woowa
cells: The bonus from Prisma Bubbles and Exalted Stamps is +3% higher

entries.label: Yet Another Printer Multi
cells: +5% printer output every day for 20 days, resets when taking a new sample!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 42 legend talents in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
